text:
release-bot: [deploybot] AUTO-PAUSE: Helm canary for chart=redwood-inference-api v2.1.3 flagged. eu-west-1 canary (3%) -> spike in 502s, error-rate 8% over baseline. Canary paused.

maya: what exactly changed in values or chart? any diffs from previous promoted?

release-bot: canary_diff: values/overrides/eu-west.yaml shows `enable_legacy_mode: false` and `replicaCount: 4` (previously 2). Also image tag differs: image: inference:v2.1.3 -> v2.1.3-secfix

liam: thanks. that replica bump + legacy flag could trigger race on startup hooking to stateful migration. my vote: do not roll forward chart change. revert values to previous for eu-west and promote image-only hotpatch.

sana: agree. can we do an image-only promote without touching Helm chart version? i.e. pin chart to v2.1.2 and do helm upgrade --set image.tag=... with reuseValues?

alex: yes, run image-only release. command:```bash
helm upgrade redwood-inference-api ./chart --namespace prod-eu 
  --reuse-values 
  --set image.tag=v2.1.3-hotfix-2026-03-21 
  --set valuesOverride=none
```
We should avoid bumping chart version and avoid the legacy flag flip.

jun: small nit: deploy-bot may have already advanced canary metadata. we need a manual pin in releasebot before retry, otherwise automated promotion might reintroduce the values change.

liam: good call. plan: (1) manual pin chart version back to 2.1.2 for eu-west namespace in releasebot, (2) run image-only helm upgrade to v2.1.3-hotfix, reuse-values, (3) promote staggered canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m health gates.

maya: tagging action owners: @jun you pin releasebot for eu-west, @alex you run the hotpatch, @sana you draft release notes snippet. I'll monitor metrics and coordinate rollback if error rate >5% after any step.

sana: will do. release notes draft: "hotfix: revert eu-west values flip (enable_legacy_mode) + image patch to address startup race causing 502s; no chart version bump; safe promote schedule." will paste in #release-notes for final signoff.

jun: pinned chart=2.1.2 for eu-west in releasebot with annotation `manual-pin: emergency-eu-fastpatch`. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: pin acknowledged. auto-promote disabled for canary until manual-clear.

alex: starting image-only helm upgrade now (dry-run first). logs: ```
[helm] Performing upgrade (dry-run) ... ok
[helm] Applying image:v2.1.3-hotfix-2026-03-21 ... ok (simulated)
```
Will run live in 2m.

maya: thanks. once first gate (5%) looks stable for 10m we'll continue. if 502 > 3% revert to previous image and unpin chart.

liam: also note runbook: if error persists, we rollback to chart v2.1.1 clusterwide and open a postmortem.

alex: live deploy done to 5%. health: 502s back to 0.8% for now. monitoring dashboard link: https://observability.internal/redwood/releases/3832129999

maya: :thumbsup: keep eyes on latency p95 as well. I'll update incident channel if anything spikes.

sana: pasted release note draft in #release-notes. tagging product for wording.

jun: after 15m gate stable, I'll schedule staged promotes at 25% and 100% (manual approve). we keep chart pin until 24h post-promote.

liam: approved. after full promote update release notes with final image tag and changelog entry.

maya: everyone ack and we'll close this thread once 100% and stable for 24h. :white_check_mark:

liam: ack.

alex: ack.

jun: ack.

sana: ack.
